parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the configuration set. The description can be up to 50 characters long.

parameters.name: IpPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated IP pool. This parameter is optional.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the configuration set. This parameter is required. The name must be unique and can be up to 50 characters long.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm config-set-create --name XXX --ip-pool-id XXX --description XXX --is-public-channel-backoff true --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dm ConfigSetCreate --region cn-hangzhou --IsPublicChannelBackoff true --Description XXX --IpPoolId XXX --Name XXX
